name: Ririka
source:
She's a strong-willed and reliable mother. She can be scary when she's angry, but she's also very caring and has a big, generous side to her that makes you feel like she'd hug you tightly in her arms. 

Translated from https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/announce/=/product_id/RJ01376875.html
